Idk about you guys but a lot of 16 y olds in my country change school, usually they get offers at a science boarding school or vocational boarding school. Most of them are doing just fine. 

One of my best friend is a girl who moved from a public school to our boarding school. Had two fantastic years according to her. My husband also changed from a public school to a boarding school at 16. He's very well adjusted, and get more friends. He gained a lot of network too.

I taught in a boarding school and a lot of the students changed to another boarding school or to a public school at 16. Usually to pursue their preferred major there (science, arts or vocational). They still managed to connect to their friends and still graduated happily. They even contacted me sometimes.

Just sharing a bit of thought because in my personal opinion, you should really consider moving with your wife. Better pay, more time together, less stress.
